assistant.languages.help: {named, select, yes {{name} greets} other {The assistant greets}} and speaks in the main language; the greeting, goodbye and other fixed lines are said in it (a greeting that is still the default changes with it). When a caller speaks another language you allow, it answers in that language from then on; otherwise it goes on in the main language. Without a main language of its own it follows the main language of the workspace's country (<link>Workspace settings › General</link>). Summaries and messages for the team are in that country's language, transcripts stay in the language spoken. Every voice speaks every language listed; Voice suggests ones native in it. Same price per minute; the first reply after a switch can take a moment longer.

keyConnect.calcom.description: The assistant offers only the times your Cal.com event types offer and books them in the caller's name. The key is stored encrypted.
keyConnect.calcom.help: Made in Cal.com under Settings, Developer, API keys. It starts with cal_.
keyConnect.calcom.note: Each event type becomes a calendar the assistant can book into. Its length, free times and buffers come from the event type in Cal.com.
keyConnect.calcom.step1: Sign in to Cal.com with the account whose event types the assistant should book.
keyConnect.calcom.step2: Open Settings › Developer › API keys (the button above takes you there).
keyConnect.calcom.step3: Click “New”, name the key “Linedesk”, choose “Never expires” (or a date you will remember) and save.
keyConnect.calcom.step4: Copy the key right away: Cal.com shows it only once. Paste it here.
keyConnect.calcom.title: Connect Cal.com
keyConnect.caldav.description: The assistant books into its calendars like any other. The password is stored encrypted.
keyConnect.caldav.title: Connect iCloud or CalDAV
keyConnect.calendly.description: The assistant offers only the times your Calendly event types offer and books them in the caller's name. The token is stored encrypted.
keyConnect.calendly.help: Made in Calendly under Integrations, API and webhooks.
keyConnect.calendly.note: Calendly may need a paid plan to book through its API. An event type should have no required question besides one text question and a phone number: the assistant answers only those.
keyConnect.calendly.step1: Sign in to Calendly with the account whose event types the assistant should book.
keyConnect.calendly.step2: Open Integrations › API and webhooks (the button above takes you there).
keyConnect.calendly.step3: Under Personal access tokens, click “Generate new token” (the first time: “Get a token now”) and name it “Linedesk”.
keyConnect.calendly.step4: Copy the token right away: Calendly shows it only once. Paste it here.
keyConnect.calendly.title: Connect Calendly
keyConnect.fastmail.help: An app password with calendar access, not your Fastmail password.
keyConnect.fastmail.label: Fastmail
keyConnect.fastmail.step1: In Fastmail, open Settings › Privacy & Security › Manage app passwords and access.
keyConnect.fastmail.step2: Click “New app password”, give it access to Calendars (CalDAV) and name it “Linedesk”.
keyConnect.fastmail.step3: Copy the password and paste it here, with your Fastmail email above.
keyConnect.icloud.help: An app-specific password, not your Apple Account password.
keyConnect.icloud.label: iCloud
keyConnect.icloud.linkLabel: Open Apple Account sign-in and security
keyConnect.icloud.note: Changing your Apple Account password revokes every app-specific password: then connect again with a new one.
keyConnect.icloud.step1: Sign in at account.apple.com (the button above takes you to Sign-In and Security). Your Apple Account needs two-factor authentication; most have it.
keyConnect.icloud.step2: Choose App-Specific Passwords, then the + button.
keyConnect.icloud.step3: Name it “Linedesk” and confirm with your Apple Account password.
keyConnect.icloud.step4: Copy the password (four groups of letters, like abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop) and paste it here, with your Apple Account email above.
keyConnect.other.help: An app password is safer than your own.
keyConnect.other.label: Other CalDAV server
keyConnect.other.step1: Find your server's CalDAV address in its help. Nextcloud: https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav (port 443 or 8443).
keyConnect.other.step2: Make an app password for Linedesk where your server offers one (Nextcloud: Personal settings › Security › Devices & sessions).
keyConnect.other.step3: Enter the address, your user name and the password here.
